text:
Situation: Protamine sulfate manufactured by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC at FEI 1450022 has been on FDA's shortage list as "To Be Discontinued" since 2021-04-20. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been listed for 66 months. Corvale East holds 293 units at 9.4 per day (31 days on hand). Corvale General holds 160 units at 10.7 per day (15 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1123748 at FEI 1450022 ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2024-05-22. A second OAI inspection (1174894) ended 2022-06-30 with classification letter dated 2024-04-30. The most recent inspection (1216183) ended 2023-08-24 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month at Corvale East and two weeks at Corvale General. The manufacturer's discontinuation status and extended shortage duration indicate supply will not recover from this source.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase of protamine sulfate from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer verifies HealthFirst product labeling and supply continuity; requires P&T committee review of alternate source documentation.
3. Pharmacy director allocates existing Fresenius Kabi stock to highest-priority cases pending alternate supply; requires P&T committee endorsement of allocation criteria.

Not recommended: Delaying alternate sourcing until current stock is depleted.
